obligations.ask: Provide a written response about the tenancy account

results.segment: A written response about the tenancy account is required within 28 days of the date of this letter.
The tenancy account is being checked by the department that holds it, and any correction is applied automatically within 30 days.
This part of the letter is sent for information only.
We received your completed form on 11 April, so there is nothing further to send.
